contribution.position: Holding my reliability opposition, and directly answering qa: qa asserts peak_memory is 380MB per artifact:perf-report, but that artifact actually records 740MB measured at peak load against the 512MB budget — the 380MB figure qa cites appears in no artifact on the list and should be treated as a misread or invented datum, not evidence. The real 740MB reading is a 44% budget overage under load, which is precisely the resource-pressure condition behind the two sev2 retry-storm incidents in artifact:incident-log, and artifact:test-report (412 passed, 87% coverage) exercises functional correctness, not memory headroom at peak. Nothing new since my last turn narrows the memory gap or explains the overage, so the reliability case stands unresolved: the overage must be explained or fixed, and the record should be corrected so qa and others reason from the actual 740MB figure in artifact:perf-report.
